learned: Words such as quiet, soft, faint and gentle come back almost silent. Ask for the sound at full strength and let the chain set its level.

Measured with two 3 second test calls of the same rain prompt at 03:56 UTC: with loop true the take is 12 dB quieter and carries a quarter of its energy under 60 Hz, with loop false it has none there. Ambience is therefore asked for with loop false, and the chain makes the loop.

A cue of one second or less comes back as one event. Every first take that asked for two things in a row, a scrape then a slosh, a thud then crackling, came back as a single clink. A cue with two parts is asked for at 2.5 seconds or more and cut to its length by the chain.
The word glass at the head of a prompt gives a clink whatever else is asked. The next takes name the heavy thing and the stone first.
Hand, strokes and stir bring a spoon into the glass. The next shake take asks for a sealed jar.

An ambience prompt that names an instrument, bells, gets a passage of that instrument up close. The other seasons' ambience asks for one steady bed and names its distant detail as far away and sparse.
